name: Lateral Movement: RDP Followed by Credential Access
description: Detects lateral movement: rdp followed by credential access — lateral movement chain correlation
query: sequence by user.name with maxspan=30m [authentication where event.outcome:success and network.protocol:rdp] [process where process.name:procdump.exe and process.args:*lsass*]

name: Lateral Movement: SSH Followed by Privilege Escalation
description: Detects lateral movement: ssh followed by privilege escalation — lateral movement chain correlation
query: sequence by user.name with maxspan=15m [authentication where event.outcome:success and network.protocol:ssh and source.ip:*] [process where process.name:sudo and process.args:*root*]

name: Lateral Movement: SMB Share Access Followed by File Encryption
description: Detects lateral movement: smb share access followed by file encryption — lateral movement chain correlation
query: sequence by user.name with maxspan=30m [file where event.action:accessed and network.protocol:smb] [process where process.args:("-encrypt" OR "gpg --encrypt")]

name: Lateral Movement: WMI Remote Execution Followed by Persistence
description: Detects lateral movement: wmi remote execution followed by persistence — lateral movement chain correlation
query: sequence by host.name with maxspan=20m [process where process.name:wmic.exe and process.args:*exec*] [registry where registry.path:*\\Run\\*]

name: Lateral Movement: PsExec Followed by Discovery
description: Detects lateral movement: psexec followed by discovery — lateral movement chain correlation
query: sequence by user.name with maxspan=15m [process where process.name:psexec.exe or process.name:psexec64.exe] [process where process.name:(systeminfo OR ipconfig OR net.exe)]

name: Lateral Movement: PowerShell Remoting Followed by Credential Dumping
description: Detects lateral movement: powershell remoting followed by credential dumping — lateral movement chain correlation
query: sequence by user.name with maxspan=10m [process where process.name:powershell.exe and process.args:*-remoting*] [process where process.name:(procdump.exe OR taskmgr.exe) and process.args:*lsass*]

name: Lateral Movement: WinRM Followed by Defense Evasion
description: Detects lateral movement: winrm followed by defense evasion — lateral movement chain correlation
query: sequence by user.name with maxspan=20m [authentication where event.outcome:success and network.protocol:winrm] [process where process.name:powershell.exe and process.args:("-enc" OR "FromBase64String")]

name: Lateral Movement: Kerberoasting Followed by Lateral Movement
description: Detects lateral movement: kerberoasting followed by lateral movement — lateral movement chain correlation
query: sequence by user.name with maxspan=30m [process where process.name:powershell.exe and process.args:*Kerberoast*] [authentication where event.outcome:success and source.ip:*]

name: Lateral Movement: DCSync Attack Chain
description: Detects lateral movement: dcsync attack chain — lateral movement chain correlation
query: sequence by user.name with maxspan=10m [process where process.name:mimikatz.exe or process.args:*lsadump*] [process where process.args:*dcsync*]

name: Lateral Movement: Pass-the-Hash Detection
description: Detects lateral movement: pass-the-hash detection — lateral movement chain correlation
query: authentication where event.outcome:success and user.name:* AND NOT source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 OR 172.16.0.0/12 OR 192.168.0.0/16) and process.name:* and process.hash.*:known_hash
